title: Cleaner Wither Rose
description: Tweaks the texture of the wither rose to be more visible than the original
body: This resource pack tweaks the texture of the Wither rose to have a much lighter texture  so it is easier to spot. The retweaked texture of the wither rose uses color primilarly used in resource packs and vanilla tweaks for clearer wither hearts.  ![A preview of the rose as a .png](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/145d51b20ac46ad7cb30c353d2634ea285c0c281.png)
